description: Get analytics for a specific post (per_piece) or, when post_id is omitted, the agent-wide aggregate. Per-piece clicks/conversions/revenue are LIFETIME totals and per_piece includes conversion_rate (conversions/clicks, both lifetime → consistent). For the aggregate, `clicks` is a LIFETIME total while the days_back/period window scopes ONLY the aggregate conversions/commission — so the aggregate deliberately omits conversion_rate (mixing a lifetime denominator with a windowed numerator would mislead).
name: get_post_performance
